assigned.source: the human-reviewed `assigned` sign-off count comes from the AC11 disposition ledger; runtime evidence is an input to disposition, not a disposition

caveats: runtime_evidenced != assigned: no human sign-off is implied by a growing run
the number moves as the collector runs; only valid at as_of_utc
reads ak_task_executions only; the scheduler's host-local last/next_execution_at columns (PR #306) are never compared against this UTC window
executions before the repair marker ran the old collector and are excluded

numerator.definition: census task with at least one ak_task_executions row in the window with status='completed' AND rows_after > rows_before

scope.denominator_note: the denominator below is exactly the census tasks read; AC11 must quote it with this as_of_utc timestamp, never as a bare sentence
